+template flatMemoryStep[Width: static[int]; Loading, Signed, Indirect, ImmediateStore: static[
+    bool]](f: var FlatFrame, off: uint32) =
+  ## Expand the one shared checked memory equation; failures return before any following operation.
+  block:
+    let a = f.arguments[int(off)]
+    var base = 0'u64
+    when Indirect:
+      when Loading or not ImmediateStore: base = uint64(f.info.registers[a.slots.bIndex])
+      else: base = uint64(f.info.registers[a.slots.aIndex])
+    let address = (base+a.x) and 0xffffffff'u64
+    when Loading:
+      var value = 0'u64
+      if not flatLoad[Width](f, off, address, value): return flatStop
+      when Signed:
+        let bits = Width*8
+        if (value and (1'u64 shl (bits-1))) != 0: value = value or (high(uint64) shl bits)
+      f.info.registers[a.slots.aIndex] = RegisterValue(value)
+    else:
+      let value = when ImmediateStore: flatSext32(a.y) else: uint64(f.info.registers[
+          a.slots.aIndex])
+      if not flatStore[Width](f, off, address, value): return flatStop

+proc flatStoreRegister(f: var FlatFrame, off: uint32): uint32 =

+  flatMemoryStep[1, false, false, true, false](f, off)
